name: stress-ng vdso
description: Start N workers that repeatedly call each of the system call functions in the vDSO (virtual dynamic shared object). The vDSO is a shared library that the kernel maps into the address space of all user-space applications to allow fast access to kernel data to some system calls without the need of performing an expensive system call. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
